sourceDescription: User-supplied reference images, identified as Dune Wiki (Fandom) files, all uploaded by Eshogun671 as 2500 by 2500 PNGs; the stored originals are the wiki's 1000 px WebP conversions. Read through the wiki API on 2026-11-05: no file page states a license (the wiki-wide footer says CC-BY-SA, which no page says applies to these images), and the uploader is not stated to be the maker. Per-asset statedCreator and statedSource record what the file page says. The House Atreus reference is labeled fan art.
preparation: Alpha (foreground) of the 1000 px reference, cropped to sourceCrop and padded by 4 px; 4x Lanczos resize of the anti-aliased alpha, then threshold at 50 percent, so edges are decided at 4x and no source-pixel staircase survives; Potrace (potracer port of Potrace 1.16), turdsize 16, alphamax 1, opttolerance 0.2; the bitmapMaster is that thresholded 4x mask. Dune Zone normalization and stamp. Re-traced 2026-11-05 to remove stair-stepping left by thresholding before the resize.

approval.scope: The user approved the nine cropped, recolorable SVGs shown together in the preview grid: "I like these".
